title: Two Countries One Heart — EN/SN/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk mbira acoustic guitar Shona Portuguese language learning warm baritone 106bpm Zimbabwe-Australia journey celebration trilingual storytelling
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
She brought the red dust with her
In the way she says hello to strangers
In the way she stands in a doorway
Taking the measure of a room

[Verse 2 - Shona, with English translations]
Akauya nenyoro yeguruva dzvuku (She came with the red dust within her)
Munzira yaanotaura navanhu vasina kuzivana (In the way she greets strangers)
Munzira yaanomira pamukova (In the way she stands in a doorway)
Achiyera imba (Taking the measure of a room)
Mufaro ndewose (Happiness belongs to everyone)
Izvi ndizvo zvaaiziva asati aziva zita rake (This is what she knew before she knew his name)
Tinotenda (We are grateful)
Nekuda kwenzvimbo yakaita kuti vasvike pamwe chete (For the distance that brought them together)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
Dois países, um coração (Two countries, one heart)
Zimbábue de manhã (Zimbabwe in the morning)
Austrália de tarde (Australia in the evening)
Dois países, um coração (Two countries, one heart)
O mbira e o melro (The mbira and the magpie)
Cantando juntos (Singing together)
Dois países, um coração (Two countries, one heart)
O único mapa de que precisam (The only map they need)

[Bridge - all three]
English: They built a third country — the one not on any map
Shona: Vakavaka nyika yechitatu — iyo isingaonekwe pamapa (They built a third country not found on any map)
Portuguese: Construíram um terceiro país — que não está em nenhum mapa (They built a third country on no map)

[Outro - all three]
English: Two countries — one heart — yes
Shona: Nyika mbiri — moyo mumwe — hongu (Two countries — one heart — yes)
Portuguese: Dois países — um coração — sim (Two countries — one heart — yes)
